title: Mischna and Ghemara
html_source: The Mishnah is a very early collection of Jewish oral tradition that teaches Jewish law through the presentation of cases. The Gemara consists of Rabbinical analyses and commentaries on the Mishnah. As indicated here, the Talmud comprises both.
